svg.text: NEMA14 RP2040 | Flash, Clock & MCU Supply
A4 landscape | 3 / 4 | Named nets connect across sheets | NC = intentionally unused pin

text.tspan: U_FLASH / GD25Q16 provides 2 MB firmware storage.
RP2040 has no internal flash. BOOT shorts QSPI_SS via R_BOOT
to ground during reset, entering the ROM USB bootloader.
Y_MCU / ABM8 is the USB clock reference.
Load capacitors support oscillation; R_XOUT limits crystal drive.
Each capacitor is a distinct fitted part.
IO pin numbers appear in references.
VREG_OUT feeds V1V1; no external 1.1 V source.
